Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human CB1 receptor (CHEMBL218) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL218 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Alias the identifier column as compound_chembl_id. Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
